lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots show increasing spatial separation and diameter as they progress toward the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal rows of spots, creating a semi-regular grid pattern where the spots serve as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible across the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal aspect of the ridge to localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular high-luminance patches and structural irregularities are visible on the distal tip and trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating localized tissue trauma or abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, low-luminance linear object is positioned adjacent to the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
